statement: MAX_LOCK_HORIZON: a party refuses a lock whose deadline is beyond its horizon (deadline_too_far), and a hub refuses to forward one. The Quint cell holds the Account-level refusal (deadline_too_far past view + horizon + reserve); a hub refusing to forward such a lock is not tested at the Entity layer.
